ADDRESS CHANGE CHECKLIST
Columbus, OH to Portland, OR
Move Day: Fri 01/15/2027, Drive starts Sat 01/16

====== 4 WEEKS BEFORE (by 12/18/2026) ======

☐ USPS mail forwarding (usps.com, set activation to 01/15 or 01/16)
☐ Employer / payroll (new address for W-2 and tax withholding)
☐ Banks and checking accounts
☐ Credit cards (all cards, including store cards)
☐ Investment and retirement accounts
☐ Health insurance (update address and check Oregon network)
☐ Auto insurance (update address and confirm Oregon coverage)
☐ Renter's or homeowner's insurance (new policy for Portland)
☐ Life insurance
☐ Student loans and loan servicers
☐ Social Security Administration (ssa.gov)
☐ IRS (file Form 8822 or update when you file taxes)

====== 2 WEEKS BEFORE (by 01/01/2027) ======

☐ Electric, gas, water (cancel Ohio, start Oregon)
☐ Internet and cable (cancel Ohio, confirm Oregon install)
☐ Trash and recycling (cancel Ohio, confirm Oregon)
☐ Cell phone provider (update billing address)
☐ Subscriptions: streaming (Netflix, Spotify, etc.)
☐ Subscriptions: news, magazines, meal kits
☐ Online shopping accounts (Amazon, Target, etc.)
☐ Pharmacy and prescription refills (transfer to Oregon pharmacy)
☐ Doctors, dentist, specialists (request records transfer)
☐ Vet records (request transfer to new Oregon vet)
☐ Pet microchip registry (update after arrival)
☐ Gym or club memberships (cancel or transfer)
☐ Cloud storage and app accounts with billing addresses
☐ Professional licenses or certifications (if address is on file)

====== 1 WEEK BEFORE (by 01/08/2027) ======

☐ Confirm USPS forwarding activation date
☐ Confirm all utility start dates in Oregon in writing
☐ Confirm all utility end dates in Ohio in writing
☐ Update Amazon, online grocery, and delivery app addresses
☐ Update any auto-ship or recurring delivery addresses

====== AFTER ARRIVAL (by 01/29/2027) ======

☐ Oregon driver's license (bring proof of residency)
☐ Oregon vehicle registration (check emissions requirements)
☐ Cancel Ohio plates and registration (after Oregon registration)
☐ Voter registration (sos.oregon.gov, often automatic at DMV)
☐ Update pet microchip registry to Portland address
☐ Get Oregon dog license from county or city
☐ Register with a new Oregon vet
☐ Register with a new Oregon pharmacy
☐ Register with new Oregon doctors, dentist, specialists
☐ Update any remaining accounts you missed

====== TIPS ======

- Screenshot each confirmation as you go.
- Use a single email folder or label named "Address changes" to store all confirmations.
- Check for missed accounts by reviewing your last 3 months of bank and credit card statements for recurring charges.
- Keep your Ohio address on file with the IRS until you file your part-year returns for both states.
